nodes.description: Groups are drawn first, behind everything; the rest after the edges.

edges.description: Arrows, drawn over the groups and under the shapes they connect.

notes.description: Annotations, drawn over everything but the raw callbacks.

description: A hand-sketched diagram as plain data. Coordinates are given, never computed: pensketch performs no layout and never measures text, so a box does not grow to fit its label. The `raw` escape hatch is absent because it holds functions, which JSON cannot carry.

id.description: How edges name this node. Unique within the diagram.

w.description: Width of the box in px.

h.description: Height of the box in px.

shape.description: Selects the group treatment: a wash, a border, and a title.

lines.description: The title, drawn inside the top left corner in `theme.pen`.

anyOf.description: A titled region drawn behind everything else. Its title is drawn unconditionally, so `lines` is required here and optional on every other shape: an untitled group cannot render.

id.description: How edges name this node. Unique within the diagram.

w.description: Width of the box in px.

h.description: Height of the box in px.

shape.description: Which outline to trace around the box.

lines.description: Label lines, one `<text>` each. Omit for an unlabelled shape.

size.description: Label font size in px. Default: `13.5`.

hatch.description: Shade the interior, inset 4 px, in `theme.pen`. Default: `false`.

anyOf.description: A drawn node, with an optional label centered in its box.

DiagramNode.description: Anything a diagram can place: a group, or one of the drawn shapes.

from.description: The id of the node to leave, and which side to leave from.

to.description: The id of the node to reach, and which side the head lands on.

via.description: Corner points between the two anchors.

dotted.description: Dash the line and recolor it, and its label, to `theme.accent`.

label.description: A single line of text. Requires `lx` and `ly`.

lx.description: Label x. `draw` throws if `label` is set and this is not a number.

ly.description: Label y. `draw` throws if `label` is set and this is not a number.

anchor.description: Which end of the label sits on `lx`. Default: `'middle'`.

DiagramEdge.description: An arrow from one node's side to another's. The path is exactly the legs between the anchors and whatever `via` points are given, in order: nothing routes around obstacles.

Side.description: Which side of a node's box an edge attaches to: top, bottom, left, right.

Point.description: An `[x, y]` position in the diagram's own coordinate space, which is the one the `<svg>` viewBox declares rather than screen pixels.

x.description: Horizontal origin of the text; `anchor` says which end of it sits here.

y.description: Vertical center of the whole block of lines.

lines.description: The lines of the note, one `<text>` each.

anchor.description: Which end of the text sits on `x`. Default: `'start'`.

arrowTo.description: Where the pointer arrow ends. Drawn only when both ends are given.

DiagramNote.description: Free-standing annotation text in `theme.accent`, optionally with a dotted arrow pointing at what it is about.
